applicability.combination_note_en: Combine with a road, place or entrance to record legal access restriction; never infer wheelchair accessibility.
applicability.combination_note_zh: 法律/管理访问限制；与道路、设施或入口主标签组合；不表示轮椅无障碍。 不能作为轮椅无障碍的正面证据。

entries.description_en: Legal or managed access is restricted to private users; it does not describe physical wheelchair access.
entries.description_zh: 法律或管理规定仅私人可通行,不说明轮椅能否通过。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Private access restriction with Wheelchair accessible: Legal or managed access is restricted to private users; it does not describe physical wheelchair access. In contrast, The mapped object has unrestricted wheelchair access, but this tag alone does not establish an accessible route to it.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“私人通行限制”误作“轮椅可达”:法律或管理规定仅私人可通行,不说明轮椅能否通过。 后者是:对象允许轮椅无障碍使用,但此标签不能证明通往它的整条路线可达。

entries.description_en: An aerodrome, airport, or airfield facility.
entries.description_zh: 机场、航空站或供航空器起降的场地。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Airport terminal for this feature: Aerodrome means an aerodrome, airport, or airfield facility, whereas Airport terminal means a passenger building at an airport.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“航空场”误标为“机场航站楼”:“航空场”指机场、航空站或供航空器起降的场地;后者指机场内供旅客办理出发、到达和换乘的建筑。

entries.description_en: An obsolete compatibility tag; use aeroway=aerodrome for an airport.
entries.description_zh: 已废弃的兼容标签;机场应使用 aeroway=aerodrome。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Aerodrome for this feature: Airport (legacy tag) means an obsolete compatibility tag; use aeroway=aerodrome for an airport, whereas Aerodrome means an aerodrome, airport, or airfield facility.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“机场(旧标签)”误标为“航空场”:“机场(旧标签)”指已废弃的兼容标签;机场应使用 aeroway=aerodrome;后者指机场、航空站或供航空器起降的场地。

entries.description_en: A passenger building at an airport.
entries.description_zh: 机场内供旅客办理出发、到达和换乘的建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Aerodrome for this feature: Airport terminal means a passenger building at an airport, whereas Aerodrome means an aerodrome, airport, or airfield facility.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“机场航站楼”误标为“航空场”:“机场航站楼”指机场内供旅客办理出发、到达和换乘的建筑;后者指机场、航空站或供航空器起降的场地。

entries.description_en: A self-service machine for financial transactions, distinct from a staffed bank branch.
entries.description_zh: 提供金融自助交易的设备,不等同于有人值守的银行网点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Cash machine with Bank branch: A self-service machine for financial transactions, distinct from a staffed bank branch. In contrast, A financial establishment offering customer services such as deposits and loans.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“自动取款机”误作“银行网点”:提供金融自助交易的设备,不等同于有人值守的银行网点。 后者是:提供存款、贷款等服务的金融机构网点。

entries.description_en: A financial establishment offering customer services such as deposits and loans.
entries.description_zh: 提供存款、贷款等服务的金融机构网点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Bank branch with Cash machine: A financial establishment offering customer services such as deposits and loans. In contrast, A self-service machine for financial transactions, distinct from a staffed bank branch.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“银行网点”误作“自动取款机”:提供存款、贷款等服务的金融机构网点。 后者是:提供金融自助交易的设备,不等同于有人值守的银行网点。

entries.description_en: A venue focused on serving alcoholic drinks, usually without a full meal service.
entries.description_zh: 以供应酒精饮品为主、通常不提供完整正餐服务的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Pub for this feature: Bar means a venue focused on serving alcoholic drinks, usually without a full meal service, whereas Pub means a venue serving alcoholic drinks in a social setting, often with food.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“酒吧”误标为“酒馆”:“酒吧”指以供应酒精饮品为主、通常不提供完整正餐服务的场所;后者指在社交环境中供应酒精饮品并常提供餐食的场所。

entries.description_en: A fixed place for one or more people to sit, without implying weather protection.
entries.description_zh: 供一人或多人坐下休息的设施,不表示可遮风避雨。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Public bench with Weather shelter: A fixed place for one or more people to sit, without implying weather protection. In contrast, A small structure protecting people from bad weather, without implying seating.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“公共长椅”误作“避雨棚”:供一人或多人坐下休息的设施,不表示可遮风避雨。 后者是:用于遮挡恶劣天气的小型构筑物,不必然有座椅。

entries.description_en: A designated place for parking bicycles.
entries.description_zh: 专门用于停放自行车的地点或设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Bicycle rental for this feature: Bicycle parking means a designated place for parking bicycles, whereas Bicycle rental means a place where bicycles can be rented.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“自行车停车处”误标为“自行车租赁点”:“自行车停车处”指专门用于停放自行车的地点或设施;后者指提供自行车租赁服务的地点。

entries.description_en: A place where bicycles can be rented.
entries.description_zh: 提供自行车租赁服务的地点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Bicycle parking for this feature: Bicycle rental means a place where bicycles can be rented, whereas Bicycle parking means a designated place for parking bicycles.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“自行车租赁点”误标为“自行车停车处”:“自行车租赁点”指提供自行车租赁服务的地点;后者指专门用于停放自行车的地点或设施。

entries.description_en: An outdoor area where beer and food are served at shared tables.
entries.description_zh: 在户外公共桌位供应啤酒和餐食的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Pub for this feature: Beer garden means an outdoor area where beer and food are served at shared tables, whereas Pub means a venue serving alcoholic drinks in a social setting, often with food.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“露天啤酒园”误标为“酒馆”:“露天啤酒园”指在户外公共桌位供应啤酒和餐食的场所;后者指在社交环境中供应酒精饮品并常提供餐食的场所。

entries.description_en: A larger bus facility where routes start, end or connect; a single roadside stop is different.
entries.description_zh: 多条巴士线路始发、终到或换乘的场站,区别于单个路边站点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Bus station with Bus stop: A larger bus facility where routes start, end or connect; a single roadside stop is different. In contrast, A point where buses stop to pick up or set down passengers.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“公交客运站”误作“公交车站”:多条巴士线路始发、终到或换乘的场站,区别于单个路边站点。 后者是:公交车辆上下乘客的停靠点。

entries.description_en: An informal place serving coffee, refreshments, and light meals.
entries.description_zh: 提供咖啡、饮品和简餐的非正式堂食场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Restaurant for this feature: Cafe means an informal place serving coffee, refreshments, and light meals, whereas Restaurant means a place serving prepared full meals, usually for consumption on site.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“咖啡馆”误标为“餐厅”:“咖啡馆”指提供咖啡、饮品和简餐的非正式堂食场所;后者指提供完整正餐并通常供顾客现场用餐的场所。

entries.description_en: A place where customers rent cars, distinct from a shared-car pickup station.
entries.description_zh: 向顾客出租汽车的营业地点,区别于共享汽车取还站。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Car rental location with Car sharing station: A place where customers rent cars, distinct from a shared-car pickup station. In contrast, A station for collecting a booked shared car, often in a marked parking area.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“汽车租赁点”误作“共享汽车站点”:向顾客出租汽车的营业地点,区别于共享汽车取还站。 后者是:领取预订共享汽车的站点,常设在划定停车区域。

entries.description_en: A station for collecting a booked shared car, often in a marked parking area.
entries.description_zh: 领取预订共享汽车的站点,常设在划定停车区域。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Car sharing station with Car rental location: A station for collecting a booked shared car, often in a marked parking area. In contrast, A place where customers rent cars, distinct from a shared-car pickup station.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“共享汽车站点”误作“汽车租赁点”:领取预订共享汽车的站点,常设在划定停车区域。 后者是:向顾客出租汽车的营业地点,区别于共享汽车取还站。

entries.description_en: A facility where electric vehicles can recharge.
entries.description_zh: 供电动车辆补充电能的设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Fuel station for this feature: Vehicle charging station means a facility where electric vehicles can recharge, whereas Fuel station means a facility selling fuel for motor vehicles.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“车辆充电站”误标为“加油站”:“车辆充电站”指供电动车辆补充电能的设施;后者指向机动车提供燃油的设施。

entries.description_en: A place where children are cared for that is not a kindergarten school.
entries.description_zh: 照看儿童的机构,不等同于幼儿园教育设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Childcare facility with Kindergarten: A place where children are cared for that is not a kindergarten school. In contrast, An educational facility for young children before compulsory schooling.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“托育照护机构”误作“幼儿园”:照看儿童的机构,不等同于幼儿园教育设施。 后者是:为义务教育前幼儿提供教育与照护的机构。

entries.description_en: A place showing films to an audience.
entries.description_zh: 面向观众放映电影的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Stadium for this feature: Cinema means a place showing films to an audience, whereas Stadium means a major sports venue with spectator facilities around a field or track.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“电影院”误标为“体育场”:“电影院”指面向观众放映电影的场所;后者指围绕比赛场地或跑道设有观众设施的大型体育场馆。

entries.description_en: A medical facility providing outpatient diagnosis or treatment.
entries.description_zh: 提供门诊诊断或治疗的医疗机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Hospital for this feature: Clinic means a medical facility providing outpatient diagnosis or treatment, whereas Hospital means a medical institution with facilities for inpatient treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“诊所”误标为“医院”:“诊所”指提供门诊诊断或治疗的医疗机构;后者指具备住院治疗能力的医疗机构。

entries.description_en: An institution providing further or higher education.
entries.description_zh: 提供继续教育或高等教育的院校。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use University for this feature: College means an institution providing further or higher education, whereas University means an institution providing university-level higher education and research.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“学院”误标为“大学”:“学院”指提供继续教育或高等教育的院校;后者指提供大学层次高等教育与科研的机构。

entries.description_en: A public venue used for local community activities and services.
entries.description_zh: 用于社区活动和公共服务的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Town hall for this feature: Community centre means a public venue used for local community activities and services, whereas Town hall means a building housing local government administration or civic functions.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“社区活动中心”误标为“市政厅”:“社区活动中心”指用于社区活动和公共服务的场所;后者指承载地方政府行政或公共事务功能的建筑。

entries.description_en: A building where courts of law operate.
entries.description_zh: 法院开展审判活动的建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Town hall for this feature: Courthouse means a building where courts of law operate, whereas Town hall means a building housing local government administration or civic functions.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“法院”误标为“市政厅”:“法院”指法院开展审判活动的建筑;后者指承载地方政府行政或公共事务功能的建筑。

entries.description_en: A practice providing dental examination and treatment.
entries.description_zh: 提供牙科检查与治疗的医疗场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Doctors' office for this feature: Dentist means a practice providing dental examination and treatment, whereas Doctors' office means a medical practice where physicians consult and treat patients.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“牙科诊所”误标为“医生诊所”:“牙科诊所”指提供牙科检查与治疗的医疗场所;后者指医生为患者提供诊疗服务的门诊场所。

entries.description_en: A medical practice where physicians consult and treat patients.
entries.description_zh: 医生为患者提供诊疗服务的门诊场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Clinic for this feature: Doctors' office means a medical practice where physicians consult and treat patients, whereas Clinic means a medical facility providing outpatient diagnosis or treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“医生诊所”误标为“诊所”:“医生诊所”指医生为患者提供诊疗服务的门诊场所;后者指提供门诊诊断或治疗的医疗机构。

entries.description_en: A place where potable water is available.
entries.description_zh: 可获取安全饮用水的地点或设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Public toilets for this feature: Drinking water means a place where potable water is available, whereas Public toilets means a publicly accessible toilet facility.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“饮用水点”误标为“公共厕所”:“饮用水点”指可获取安全饮用水的地点或设施;后者指公众可使用的厕所设施。

entries.description_en: A facility offering instruction for driving motor vehicles.
entries.description_zh: 提供机动车驾驶教学的培训场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Training centre for this feature: Driving school means a facility offering instruction for driving motor vehicles, whereas Training centre means a facility providing non-school vocational or specialist training.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“驾驶学校”误标为“培训中心”:“驾驶学校”指提供机动车驾驶教学的培训场所;后者指提供非学校制职业或专业培训的机构。

entries.description_en: A place serving prepared food quickly, usually with limited table service.
entries.description_zh: 快速供应预制餐食、通常桌边服务有限的餐饮场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Restaurant for this feature: Fast-food restaurant means a place serving prepared food quickly, usually with limited table service, whereas Restaurant means a place serving prepared full meals, usually for consumption on site.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“快餐店”误标为“餐厅”:“快餐店”指快速供应预制餐食、通常桌边服务有限的餐饮场所;后者指提供完整正餐并通常供顾客现场用餐的场所。

entries.description_en: A station housing firefighters and emergency response equipment.
entries.description_zh: 驻有消防人员及应急设备的站点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Police facility for this feature: Fire station means a station housing firefighters and emergency response equipment, whereas Police facility means a facility used by police services.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“消防站”误标为“警务设施”:“消防站”指驻有消防人员及应急设备的站点;后者指警察或公安部门开展工作的设施。

entries.description_en: A shared seating area served by multiple food vendors.
entries.description_zh: 由多家餐饮摊位共同服务的集中就餐区。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Fast-food restaurant for this feature: Food court means a shared seating area served by multiple food vendors, whereas Fast-food restaurant means a place serving prepared food quickly, usually with limited table service.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“美食广场”误标为“快餐店”:“美食广场”指由多家餐饮摊位共同服务的集中就餐区;后者指快速供应预制餐食、通常桌边服务有限的餐饮场所。

entries.description_en: A facility selling fuel for motor vehicles.
entries.description_zh: 向机动车提供燃油的设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Vehicle charging station for this feature: Fuel station means a facility selling fuel for motor vehicles, whereas Vehicle charging station means a facility where electric vehicles can recharge.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“加油站”误标为“车辆充电站”:“加油站”指向机动车提供燃油的设施;后者指供电动车辆补充电能的设施。

entries.description_en: A medical institution with facilities for inpatient treatment.
entries.description_zh: 具备住院治疗能力的医疗机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Clinic for this feature: Hospital means a medical institution with facilities for inpatient treatment, whereas Clinic means a medical facility providing outpatient diagnosis or treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“医院”误标为“诊所”:“医院”指具备住院治疗能力的医疗机构;后者指提供门诊诊断或治疗的医疗机构。

entries.description_en: A place primarily selling ice cream or gelato for immediate consumption.
entries.description_zh: 以销售即食冰淇淋或意式冰淇淋为主的店铺。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Confectionery shop for this feature: Ice-cream shop means a place primarily selling ice cream or gelato for immediate consumption, whereas Confectionery shop means a shop selling sweets, candy, and confectionery.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“冰淇淋店”误标为“糖果店”:“冰淇淋店”指以销售即食冰淇淋或意式冰淇淋为主的店铺;后者指销售糖果及甜食制品的店铺。

entries.description_en: An educational facility for young children before compulsory schooling.
entries.description_zh: 为义务教育前幼儿提供教育与照护的机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use School for this feature: Kindergarten means an educational facility for young children before compulsory schooling, whereas School means an institution providing primary or secondary education.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“幼儿园”误标为“学校”:“幼儿园”指为义务教育前幼儿提供教育与照护的机构;后者指提供小学或中学阶段教育的机构。

entries.description_en: A school primarily teaching languages.
entries.description_zh: 以语言教学为主的教育机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Training centre for this feature: Language school means a school primarily teaching languages, whereas Training centre means a facility providing non-school vocational or specialist training.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“语言学校”误标为“培训中心”:“语言学校”指以语言教学为主的教育机构;后者指提供非学校制职业或专业培训的机构。

entries.description_en: A place where books and other media can be read or borrowed.
entries.description_zh: 提供图书及其他资料阅览或借阅服务的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Community centre for this feature: Library means a place where books and other media can be read or borrowed, whereas Community centre means a public venue used for local community activities and services.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“图书馆”误标为“社区活动中心”:“图书馆”指提供图书及其他资料阅览或借阅服务的场所;后者指用于社区活动和公共服务的场所。

entries.description_en: A school primarily teaching music.
entries.description_zh: 以音乐教学为主的教育机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Training centre for this feature: Music school means a school primarily teaching music, whereas Training centre means a facility providing non-school vocational or specialist training.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“音乐学校”误标为“培训中心”:“音乐学校”指以音乐教学为主的教育机构;后者指提供非学校制职业或专业培训的机构。

entries.description_en: A residential facility providing continuous nursing care.
entries.description_zh: 为住户提供持续护理的居住型机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Social facility for this feature: Nursing home means a residential facility providing continuous nursing care, whereas Social facility means a facility providing social care, support, or welfare services.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“护理院”误标为“社会服务机构”:“护理院”指为住户提供持续护理的居住型机构;后者指提供社会照护、援助或福利服务的机构。

entries.description_en: A machine for collecting or sending parcels without a staffed post office counter.
entries.description_zh: 供自助领取或寄出包裹的柜机,不等同于邮局柜台。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Parcel locker with Post office: A machine for collecting or sending parcels without a staffed post office counter. In contrast, A public branch providing postal services.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“快递自提柜”误作“邮局”:供自助领取或寄出包裹的柜机,不等同于邮局柜台。 后者是:提供寄递等邮政服务的营业场所。

entries.description_en: A designated facility or area for parking vehicles.
entries.description_zh: 供机动车停放的指定场地或设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Bicycle parking for this feature: Parking facility means a designated facility or area for parking vehicles, whereas Bicycle parking means a designated place for parking bicycles.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“停车设施”误标为“自行车停车处”:“停车设施”指供机动车停放的指定场地或设施;后者指专门用于停放自行车的地点或设施。

entries.description_en: An entrance to an underground or multi-storey parking facility, not an individual parking bay.
entries.description_zh: 地下或多层停车设施的出入口,不是一处停车位。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Parking facility entrance with Individual parking space: An entrance to an underground or multi-storey parking facility, not an individual parking bay. In contrast, One marked parking place within a larger facility, distinct from the parking lot as a whole.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“停车场出入口”误作“单个停车位”:地下或多层停车设施的出入口,不是一处停车位。 后者是:停车设施中的单个车位,区别于整个停车场。

entries.description_en: One marked parking place within a larger facility, distinct from the parking lot as a whole.
entries.description_zh: 停车设施中的单个车位,区别于整个停车场。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Individual parking space with Parking facility: One marked parking place within a larger facility, distinct from the parking lot as a whole. In contrast, A designated facility or area for parking vehicles.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“单个停车位”误作“停车设施”:停车设施中的单个车位,区别于整个停车场。 后者是:供机动车停放的指定场地或设施。

entries.description_en: A place dispensing prescription medicines and selling health products.
entries.description_zh: 配发处方药并销售健康用品的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Chemist shop for this feature: Pharmacy means a place dispensing prescription medicines and selling health products, whereas Chemist shop means a shop selling health, hygiene, and beauty products without dispensing prescriptions.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“药房”误标为“日化保健品店”:“药房”指配发处方药并销售健康用品的场所;后者指销售健康、卫生和美容用品但不配发处方药的店铺。

entries.description_en: A place used for religious services, not a general community meeting centre.
entries.description_zh: 举行宗教礼拜活动的场所,不是普通社区活动中心。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Place of worship with Community centre: A place used for religious services, not a general community meeting centre. In contrast, A public venue used for local community activities and services.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“宗教礼拜场所”误作“社区活动中心”:举行宗教礼拜活动的场所,不是普通社区活动中心。 后者是:用于社区活动和公共服务的场所。

entries.description_en: A facility used by police services.
entries.description_zh: 警察或公安部门开展工作的设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Fire station for this feature: Police facility means a facility used by police services, whereas Fire station means a station housing firefighters and emergency response equipment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“警务设施”误标为“消防站”:“警务设施”指警察或公安部门开展工作的设施;后者指驻有消防人员及应急设备的站点。

entries.description_en: A box for depositing outgoing mail, not a staffed postal office.
entries.description_zh: 供投递待寄邮件的箱体,不提供邮局柜台服务。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Postal collection box with Post office: A box for depositing outgoing mail, not a staffed postal office. In contrast, A public branch providing postal services.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“邮筒”误作“邮局”:供投递待寄邮件的箱体,不提供邮局柜台服务。 后者是:提供寄递等邮政服务的营业场所。

entries.description_en: A public branch providing postal services.
entries.description_zh: 提供寄递等邮政服务的营业场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Government office for this feature: Post office means a public branch providing postal services, whereas Government office means an office used by a government or public administration body.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“邮局”误标为“政府办公室”:“邮局”指提供寄递等邮政服务的营业场所;后者指政府或公共行政机构使用的办公场所。

entries.description_en: A venue serving alcoholic drinks in a social setting, often with food.
entries.description_zh: 在社交环境中供应酒精饮品并常提供餐食的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Bar for this feature: Pub means a venue serving alcoholic drinks in a social setting, often with food, whereas Bar means a venue focused on serving alcoholic drinks, usually without a full meal service.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“酒馆”误标为“酒吧”:“酒馆”指在社交环境中供应酒精饮品并常提供餐食的场所;后者指以供应酒精饮品为主、通常不提供完整正餐服务的场所。

entries.description_en: A facility open to the public for communal bathing, distinct from a swimming pool for sport.
entries.description_zh: 面向公众提供集体洗浴的设施,区别于用于游泳的泳池。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Public bath facility with Swimming pool: A facility open to the public for communal bathing, distinct from a swimming pool for sport. In contrast, A water basin designed for swimming.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“公共浴场”误作“游泳池”:面向公众提供集体洗浴的设施,区别于用于游泳的泳池。 后者是:专门供游泳使用的人工水池。

entries.description_en: A place for depositing recyclable materials.
entries.description_zh: 用于投放或收集可回收材料的地点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Drinking water for this feature: Recycling facility means a place for depositing recyclable materials, whereas Drinking water means a place where potable water is available.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“回收设施”误标为“饮用水点”:“回收设施”指用于投放或收集可回收材料的地点;后者指可获取安全饮用水的地点或设施。

entries.description_en: An establishment dedicated to research, distinct from a university campus as a whole.
entries.description_zh: 专门开展科研的机构,不等同于整座大学校园。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Research institute with University: An establishment dedicated to research, distinct from a university campus as a whole. In contrast, An institution providing university-level higher education and research.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“科研机构”误作“大学”:专门开展科研的机构,不等同于整座大学校园。 后者是:提供大学层次高等教育与科研的机构。

entries.description_en: A place serving prepared full meals, usually for consumption on site.
entries.description_zh: 提供完整正餐并通常供顾客现场用餐的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Cafe for this feature: Restaurant means a place serving prepared full meals, usually for consumption on site, whereas Cafe means an informal place serving coffee, refreshments, and light meals.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“餐厅”误标为“咖啡馆”:“餐厅”指提供完整正餐并通常供顾客现场用餐的场所;后者指提供咖啡、饮品和简餐的非正式堂食场所。

entries.description_en: An institution providing primary or secondary education.
entries.description_zh: 提供小学或中学阶段教育的机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use School building for this feature: School means an institution providing primary or secondary education, whereas School building means a building constructed or used as part of a school.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“学校”误标为“学校建筑”:“学校”指提供小学或中学阶段教育的机构;后者指作为学校组成部分使用的建筑。

entries.description_en: A small structure protecting people from bad weather, without implying seating.
entries.description_zh: 用于遮挡恶劣天气的小型构筑物,不必然有座椅。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Weather shelter with Public bench: A small structure protecting people from bad weather, without implying seating. In contrast, A fixed place for one or more people to sit, without implying weather protection.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“避雨棚”误作“公共长椅”:用于遮挡恶劣天气的小型构筑物,不必然有座椅。 后者是:供一人或多人坐下休息的设施,不表示可遮风避雨。

entries.description_en: A facility providing social care, support, or welfare services.
entries.description_zh: 提供社会照护、援助或福利服务的机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Nursing home for this feature: Social facility means a facility providing social care, support, or welfare services, whereas Nursing home means a residential facility providing continuous nursing care.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“社会服务机构”误标为“护理院”:“社会服务机构”指提供社会照护、援助或福利服务的机构;后者指为住户提供持续护理的居住型机构。

entries.description_en: A designated place where taxis wait for passengers.
entries.description_zh: 出租车集中等候乘客的指定地点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Bus stop for this feature: Taxi rank means a designated place where taxis wait for passengers, whereas Bus stop means a point where buses stop to pick up or set down passengers.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“出租车候客点”误标为“公交车站”:“出租车候客点”指出租车集中等候乘客的指定地点;后者指公交车辆上下乘客的停靠点。

entries.description_en: A publicly accessible telephone facility.
entries.description_zh: 公众可使用的电话设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Post office for this feature: Public telephone means a publicly accessible telephone facility, whereas Post office means a public branch providing postal services.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“公共电话”误标为“邮局”:“公共电话”指公众可使用的电话设施;后者指提供寄递等邮政服务的营业场所。

entries.description_en: A publicly accessible toilet facility.
entries.description_zh: 公众可使用的厕所设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Drinking water for this feature: Public toilets means a publicly accessible toilet facility, whereas Drinking water means a place where potable water is available.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“公共厕所”误标为“饮用水点”:“公共厕所”指公众可使用的厕所设施;后者指可获取安全饮用水的地点或设施。

entries.description_en: A building housing local government administration or civic functions.
entries.description_zh: 承载地方政府行政或公共事务功能的建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Government office for this feature: Town hall means a building housing local government administration or civic functions, whereas Government office means an office used by a government or public administration body.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“市政厅”误标为“政府办公室”:“市政厅”指承载地方政府行政或公共事务功能的建筑;后者指政府或公共行政机构使用的办公场所。

entries.description_en: A facility providing non-school vocational or specialist training.
entries.description_zh: 提供非学校制职业或专业培训的机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Language school for this feature: Training centre means a facility providing non-school vocational or specialist training, whereas Language school means a school primarily teaching languages.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“培训中心”误标为“语言学校”:“培训中心”指提供非学校制职业或专业培训的机构;后者指以语言教学为主的教育机构。

entries.description_en: An institution providing university-level higher education and research.
entries.description_zh: 提供大学层次高等教育与科研的机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use College for this feature: University means an institution providing university-level higher education and research, whereas College means an institution providing further or higher education.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“大学”误标为“学院”:“大学”指提供大学层次高等教育与科研的机构;后者指提供继续教育或高等教育的院校。

entries.description_en: A medical practice treating animals.
entries.description_zh: 为动物提供诊疗服务的医疗场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Clinic for this feature: Veterinary clinic means a medical practice treating animals, whereas Clinic means a medical facility providing outpatient diagnosis or treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“兽医诊所”误标为“诊所”:“兽医诊所”指为动物提供诊疗服务的医疗场所;后者指提供门诊诊断或治疗的医疗机构。

entries.description_en: A small, pedestrian-accessible container for litter, not a large household waste container.
entries.description_zh: 供行人丢弃零散垃圾的小容器,不是大型生活垃圾收集箱。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Pedestrian litter bin with Waste disposal container: A small, pedestrian-accessible container for litter, not a large household waste container. In contrast, A medium or large bin for bagged household or industrial waste, distinct from a litter basket.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“街头垃圾桶”误作“垃圾收集箱”:供行人丢弃零散垃圾的小容器,不是大型生活垃圾收集箱。 后者是:收集袋装家庭或工业废物的中大型容器,区别于行人垃圾桶。

entries.description_en: A medium or large bin for bagged household or industrial waste, distinct from a litter basket.
entries.description_zh: 收集袋装家庭或工业废物的中大型容器,区别于行人垃圾桶。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Waste disposal container with Pedestrian litter bin: A medium or large bin for bagged household or industrial waste, distinct from a litter basket. In contrast, A small, pedestrian-accessible container for litter, not a large household waste container.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“垃圾收集箱”误作“街头垃圾桶”:收集袋装家庭或工业废物的中大型容器,区别于行人垃圾桶。 后者是:供行人丢弃零散垃圾的小容器,不是大型生活垃圾收集箱。

applicability.combination_note_en: Combine with a route or way to record signed cycling access; it does not establish wheelchair access.
applicability.combination_note_zh: 自行车指定通行属性；与道路/路径主标签组合；不单独构成自行车道。 不能作为轮椅无障碍的正面证据。

entries.description_en: Indicates a road or object is designated for cyclists; it says nothing about wheelchair access.
entries.description_zh: 表示道路或对象指定供骑行者使用,不说明轮椅可达性。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Designated bicycle access with Designated pedestrian access: Indicates a road or object is designated for cyclists; it says nothing about wheelchair access. In contrast, Indicates a route or object is designated for pedestrians; it does not prove wheelchair access.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“指定骑行通行”误作“指定步行通行”:表示道路或对象指定供骑行者使用,不说明轮椅可达性。 后者是:表示路线或对象指定供行人通行,不能据此认定轮椅可达。

entries.description_en: A residential building divided into multiple apartments.
entries.description_zh: 划分为多个独立公寓单元的住宅建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Residential building for this feature: Apartment building means a residential building divided into multiple apartments, whereas Residential building means a building used predominantly for residential purposes.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“公寓楼”误标为“住宅建筑”:“公寓楼”指划分为多个独立公寓单元的住宅建筑;后者指主要用于居住用途的建筑。

entries.description_en: A building constructed for civic functions; its type does not prove a service is currently operating.
entries.description_zh: 为公共事务用途建造的建筑,其建筑类型不能证明服务仍在提供。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Civic-purpose building with Government office: A building constructed for civic functions; its type does not prove a service is currently operating. In contrast, An office used by a government or public administration body.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“公共事务建筑”误作“政府办公室”:为公共事务用途建造的建筑,其建筑类型不能证明服务仍在提供。 后者是:政府或公共行政机构使用的办公场所。

entries.description_en: A building constructed to house a college; the building tag does not prove active teaching.
entries.description_zh: 为学院建造的楼宇,建筑标签不能证明当前正在教学。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse College building with College: A building constructed to house a college; the building tag does not prove active teaching. In contrast, An institution providing further or higher education.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“学院建筑”误作“学院”:为学院建造的楼宇,建筑标签不能证明当前正在教学。 后者是:提供继续教育或高等教育的院校。

entries.description_en: A building used mainly for commercial activities.
entries.description_zh: 主要用于商业活动的建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Retail building for this feature: Commercial building means a building used mainly for commercial activities, whereas Retail building means a building used mainly for selling goods directly to consumers.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“商业建筑”误标为“零售商业建筑”:“商业建筑”指主要用于商业活动的建筑;后者指主要用于面向消费者零售商品的建筑。

entries.description_en: A free-standing residential house not joined to another dwelling.
entries.description_zh: 不与其他住宅相连的独立居住建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use House for this feature: Detached house means a free-standing residential house not joined to another dwelling, whereas House means a building designed as a house for one household or family.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“独立式住宅”误标为“住宅房屋”:“独立式住宅”指不与其他住宅相连的独立居住建筑;后者指为一个家庭或住户设计的住宅建筑。

entries.description_en: One private garage building, distinct from a block of separate garages.
entries.description_zh: 单间私人车库建筑,区别于成排独立车库。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Single garage building with Garage block building: One private garage building, distinct from a block of separate garages. In contrast, A block of private garages with separate units or owners, not one garage.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“独立车库建筑”误作“联排车库建筑”:单间私人车库建筑,区别于成排独立车库。 后者是:由多间独立车库构成的建筑,区别于单间车库。

entries.description_en: A block of private garages with separate units or owners, not one garage.
entries.description_zh: 由多间独立车库构成的建筑,区别于单间车库。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Garage block building with Single garage building: A block of private garages with separate units or owners, not one garage. In contrast, One private garage building, distinct from a block of separate garages.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“联排车库建筑”误作“独立车库建筑”:由多间独立车库构成的建筑,区别于单间车库。 后者是:单间私人车库建筑,区别于成排独立车库。

entries.description_en: A building forming part of a hospital; its structure alone does not prove medical services operate there.
entries.description_zh: 医院组成部分的建筑,其建筑类型不能单独证明正在提供医疗服务。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Hospital building with Hospital: A building forming part of a hospital; its structure alone does not prove medical services operate there. In contrast, A medical institution with facilities for inpatient treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“医院建筑”误作“医院”:医院组成部分的建筑,其建筑类型不能单独证明正在提供医疗服务。 后者是:具备住院治疗能力的医疗机构。

entries.description_en: A building designed for overnight rooms; its form does not prove lodging is currently offered.
entries.description_zh: 设计用于提供住宿客房的建筑,不能仅凭建筑类型断定当前营业。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Hotel-type building with Operating hotel: A building designed for overnight rooms; its form does not prove lodging is currently offered. In contrast, An establishment offering paid overnight accommodation, unlike the building type alone.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“酒店建筑”误作“营业酒店”:设计用于提供住宿客房的建筑,不能仅凭建筑类型断定当前营业。 后者是:提供付费过夜住宿的营业场所,区别于仅说明建筑用途的标签。

entries.description_en: A building designed as a house for one household or family.
entries.description_zh: 为一个家庭或住户设计的住宅建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Detached house for this feature: House means a building designed as a house for one household or family, whereas Detached house means a free-standing residential house not joined to another dwelling.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“住宅房屋”误标为“独立式住宅”:“住宅房屋”指为一个家庭或住户设计的住宅建筑;后者指不与其他住宅相连的独立居住建筑。

entries.description_en: A building used mainly for industrial production or processing.
entries.description_zh: 主要用于工业生产或加工的建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Commercial building for this feature: Industrial building means a building used mainly for industrial production or processing, whereas Commercial building means a building used mainly for commercial activities.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“工业建筑”误标为“商业建筑”:“工业建筑”指主要用于工业生产或加工的建筑;后者指主要用于商业活动的建筑。

entries.description_en: A building constructed as a kindergarten; the tag does not establish current childcare operation.
entries.description_zh: 作为幼儿园建造的楼宇,不能据此确定当前仍在提供托育服务。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Kindergarten building with Kindergarten: A building constructed as a kindergarten; the tag does not establish current childcare operation. In contrast, An educational facility for young children before compulsory schooling.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“幼儿园建筑”误作“幼儿园”:作为幼儿园建造的楼宇,不能据此确定当前仍在提供托育服务。 后者是:为义务教育前幼儿提供教育与照护的机构。

entries.description_en: A building used mainly for offices.
entries.description_zh: 主要作为办公室使用的建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Commercial building for this feature: Office building means a building used mainly for offices, whereas Commercial building means a building used mainly for commercial activities.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“办公楼”误标为“商业建筑”:“办公楼”指主要作为办公室使用的建筑;后者指主要用于商业活动的建筑。

entries.description_en: A building used predominantly for residential purposes.
entries.description_zh: 主要用于居住用途的建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Apartment building for this feature: Residential building means a building used predominantly for residential purposes, whereas Apartment building means a residential building divided into multiple apartments.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“住宅建筑”误标为“公寓楼”:“住宅建筑”指主要用于居住用途的建筑;后者指划分为多个独立公寓单元的住宅建筑。

entries.description_en: A building used mainly for selling goods directly to consumers.
entries.description_zh: 主要用于面向消费者零售商品的建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Commercial building for this feature: Retail building means a building used mainly for selling goods directly to consumers, whereas Commercial building means a building used mainly for commercial activities.

entries.description_en: The building type of a train station, distinct from the station transport feature or timetable service.

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse University building with University: A building constructed for a university; its type does not prove active education on site. In contrast, An institution providing university-level higher education and research.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“大学建筑”误作“大学”:为大学建造的楼宇,其类型不能单独证明当前教学活动。 后者是:提供大学层次高等教育与科研的机构。

entries.description_en: A building constructed for storage of goods, distinct from a whole industrial land-use area.
entries.description_zh: 用于储存货物的建筑,区别于整片工业用地区域。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Warehouse building with Industrial land use: A building constructed for storage of goods, distinct from a whole industrial land-use area. In contrast, An area mainly used by workshops, factories or warehouses, not just one warehouse building.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“仓库建筑”误作“工业用地”:用于储存货物的建筑,区别于整片工业用地区域。 后者是:主要用于车间、工厂或仓库的区域,不是单栋仓库建筑。

entries.description_en: A facility practising complementary or alternative care such as acupuncture, distinct from a general clinic.

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Unspecified healthcare centre with Healthcare clinic: A healthcare facility without a more specific service type; use a precise tag when known. In contrast, An outpatient medical facility with more staff than a doctor office and without inpatient admission.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“未细分医疗中心”误作“医疗诊所”:未说明具体服务类型的医疗机构,已知服务时应使用更精确标签。 后者是:人员多于普通医生诊所、通常不收住院病人的门诊医疗机构。

entries.description_en: An outpatient medical facility with more staff than a doctor office and without inpatient admission.
entries.description_zh: 人员多于普通医生诊所、通常不收住院病人的门诊医疗机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Healthcare clinic with Clinic: An outpatient medical facility with more staff than a doctor office and without inpatient admission. In contrast, A medical facility providing outpatient diagnosis or treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“医疗诊所”误作“诊所”:人员多于普通医生诊所、通常不收住院病人的门诊医疗机构。 后者是:提供门诊诊断或治疗的医疗机构。

entries.description_en: A dental practice service tag, often paired with the amenity dentist facility tag.
entries.description_zh: 表示牙科诊疗服务,常与牙医设施主标签并用。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Dental practice service with Dentist: A dental practice service tag, often paired with the amenity dentist facility tag. In contrast, A practice providing dental examination and treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“牙科医疗机构”误作“牙科诊所”:表示牙科诊疗服务,常与牙医设施主标签并用。 后者是:提供牙科检查与治疗的医疗场所。

entries.description_en: A physician consultation or check-up service, often added to a doctors facility.
entries.description_zh: 表示医师问诊或体检服务,常附加在医生诊所设施上。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Physician healthcare service with Doctors' office: A physician consultation or check-up service, often added to a doctors facility. In contrast, A medical practice where physicians consult and treat patients.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“医生医疗服务”误作“医生诊所”:表示医师问诊或体检服务,常附加在医生诊所设施上。 后者是:医生为患者提供诊疗服务的门诊场所。

entries.description_en: Inpatient hospital treatment service, often paired with the hospital facility tag.
entries.description_zh: 表示提供住院治疗的医院医疗服务,常与医院设施标签并用。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Hospital healthcare service with Hospital: Inpatient hospital treatment service, often paired with the hospital facility tag. In contrast, A medical institution with facilities for inpatient treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“医院医疗服务”误作“医院”:表示提供住院治疗的医院医疗服务,常与医院设施标签并用。 后者是:具备住院治疗能力的医疗机构。

entries.description_en: A healthcare laboratory performing diagnostic tests on clinical samples.
entries.description_zh: 对临床样本进行诊断检测的医疗实验室。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Clinic for this feature: Medical laboratory means a healthcare laboratory performing diagnostic tests on clinical samples, whereas Clinic means a medical facility providing outpatient diagnosis or treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“医学检验室”误标为“诊所”:“医学检验室”指对临床样本进行诊断检测的医疗实验室;后者指提供门诊诊断或治疗的医疗机构。

entries.description_en: A healthcare practice providing pregnancy and childbirth support by midwives.
entries.description_zh: 由助产士提供孕产和分娩支持的医疗服务点。

hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“助产服务点”误标为“医生诊所”:“助产服务点”指由助产士提供孕产和分娩支持的医疗服务点;后者指医生为患者提供诊疗服务的门诊场所。

entries.description_en: A facility where a nurse provides healthcare without being a physician practice.
entries.description_zh: 由护士提供医疗照护的机构,不是医师诊所。

hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“护理医疗机构”误作“医生医疗服务”:由护士提供医疗照护的机构,不是医师诊所。 后者是:表示医师问诊或体检服务,常附加在医生诊所设施上。

entries.description_en: An optometrist office providing vision examination, distinct from a shop selling eyewear.
entries.description_zh: 提供视力检查的验光机构,区别于销售眼镜的商店。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Optometrist healthcare service with Optician shop: An optometrist office providing vision examination, distinct from a shop selling eyewear. hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“验光医疗服务”误作“眼镜店”:提供视力检查的验光机构,区别于销售眼镜的商店。 后者是:销售和配制眼镜或隐形眼镜的店铺,区别于验光医疗机构。

entries.description_en: A pharmacist-led medicine dispensing service, often paired with a pharmacy facility tag.
entries.description_zh: 由药剂师提供的药品配发服务,常与药房设施标签并用。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Pharmacist healthcare service with Pharmacy: A pharmacist-led medicine dispensing service, often paired with a pharmacy facility tag. In contrast, A place dispensing prescription medicines and selling health products.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“药剂师医疗服务”误作“药房”:由药剂师提供的药品配发服务,常与药房设施标签并用。 后者是:配发处方药并销售健康用品的场所。

entries.description_en: A healthcare practice providing physical therapy and rehabilitation.
entries.description_zh: 提供物理治疗与康复服务的医疗机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Clinic for this feature: Physiotherapist means a healthcare practice providing physical therapy and rehabilitation, whereas Clinic means a medical facility providing outpatient diagnosis or treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“物理治疗诊所”误标为“诊所”:“物理治疗诊所”指提供物理治疗与康复服务的医疗机构;后者指提供门诊诊断或治疗的医疗机构。

entries.description_en: A healthcare practice providing psychotherapy.
entries.description_zh: 提供心理治疗服务的医疗机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Doctors' office for this feature: Psychotherapist means a healthcare practice providing psychotherapy, whereas Doctors' office means a medical practice where physicians consult and treat patients.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“心理治疗诊所”误标为“医生诊所”:“心理治疗诊所”指提供心理治疗服务的医疗机构;后者指医生为患者提供诊疗服务的门诊场所。

entries.description_en: A medical rehabilitation facility, often offering inpatient or residential care.
entries.description_zh: 提供医疗康复的机构,通常含住院或住宿照护。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Medical rehabilitation facility with Hospital healthcare service: A medical rehabilitation facility, often offering inpatient or residential care. In contrast, Inpatient hospital treatment service, often paired with the hospital facility tag.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“康复医疗机构”误作“医院医疗服务”:提供医疗康复的机构,通常含住院或住宿照护。 后者是:表示提供住院治疗的医院医疗服务,常与医院设施标签并用。

entries.description_en: A point where buses stop to pick up or set down passengers.
entries.description_zh: 公交车辆上下乘客的停靠点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Public transport platform for this feature: Bus stop means a point where buses stop to pick up or set down passengers, whereas Public transport platform means a place where passengers wait and board public transport vehicles.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“公交车站”误标为“公共交通站台”:“公交车站”指公交车辆上下乘客的停靠点;后者指乘客等候并上下公共交通车辆的站台。

entries.description_en: A point where people walking or cycling cross a road, not the entire footway.
entries.description_zh: 行人或骑行者穿越道路的位置,不表示整条步道。

hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“道路过街点”误作“步行道”:行人或骑行者穿越道路的位置,不表示整条步道。 后者是:主要或专供步行者通行的路径,区别于一般混合用途小路。

entries.description_zh: 主要指定供自行车行驶的道路,区别于步行道。

hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“自行车专用道”误作“步行道”:主要指定供自行车行驶的道路,区别于步行道。 后者是:主要或专供步行者通行的路径,区别于一般混合用途小路。

entries.description_en: A path mainly or exclusively for people on foot, rather than a generic mixed-use path.
entries.description_zh: 主要或专供步行者通行的路径,区别于一般混合用途小路。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Footway with General path: A path mainly or exclusively for people on foot, rather than a generic mixed-use path. In contrast, A generic path for walking, cycling or animals, without the exclusive footway meaning.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“步行道”误作“一般小路”:主要或专供步行者通行的路径,区别于一般混合用途小路。 后者是:可供步行、骑行或动物通行的一般小路,不表示专供行人。

entries.description_en: A street with very low speeds and pedestrian-friendly traffic rules, unlike an ordinary residential road.
entries.description_zh: 实行低速和行人友好交通规则的街道,区别于普通居住区道路。

hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“生活街道”误作“居住区道路”:实行低速和行人友好交通规则的街道,区别于普通居住区道路。 后者是:服务住宅区的道路,不自动具有生活街道的特殊低速规则。

entries.description_en: A generic path for walking, cycling or animals, without the exclusive footway meaning.
entries.description_zh: 可供步行、骑行或动物通行的一般小路,不表示专供行人。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse General path with Footway: A generic path for walking, cycling or animals, without the exclusive footway meaning. In contrast, A path mainly or exclusively for people on foot, rather than a generic mixed-use path.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“一般小路”误作“步行道”:可供步行、骑行或动物通行的一般小路,不表示专供行人。 后者是:主要或专供步行者通行的路径,区别于一般混合用途小路。

entries.description_en: A road mainly or exclusively for pedestrians, distinct from a narrow footway path.
entries.description_zh: 主要或专供行人的道路,区别于狭窄步行小径。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Pedestrian road with Footway: A road mainly or exclusively for pedestrians, distinct from a narrow footway path. In contrast, A path mainly or exclusively for people on foot, rather than a generic mixed-use path.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“步行街道路”误作“步行道”:主要或专供行人的道路,区别于狭窄步行小径。 后者是:主要或专供步行者通行的路径,区别于一般混合用途小路。

entries.description_en: A major road linking large towns or serving as an important urban arterial.
entries.description_zh: 连接较大城镇或承担城市主干交通的主要道路。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Primary road with Secondary road: A major road linking large towns or serving as an important urban arterial. In contrast, An arterial road linking towns, below a primary road in road hierarchy.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“一级干道”误作“二级干道”:连接较大城镇或承担城市主干交通的主要道路。 后者是:连接城镇的次要干道,道路等级低于一级干道。

entries.description_en: A road serving a residential area, without the special low-speed rules of a living street.
entries.description_zh: 服务住宅区的道路,不自动具有生活街道的特殊低速规则。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Residential road with Living street: A road serving a residential area, without the special low-speed rules of a living street. In contrast, A street with very low speeds and pedestrian-friendly traffic rules, unlike an ordinary residential road.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“居住区道路”误作“生活街道”:服务住宅区的道路,不自动具有生活街道的特殊低速规则。 后者是:实行低速和行人友好交通规则的街道,区别于普通居住区道路。

entries.description_en: An arterial road linking towns, below a primary road in road hierarchy.
entries.description_zh: 连接城镇的次要干道,道路等级低于一级干道。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Secondary road with Primary road: An arterial road linking towns, below a primary road in road hierarchy. In contrast, A major road linking large towns or serving as an important urban arterial.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“二级干道”误作“一级干道”:连接城镇的次要干道,道路等级低于一级干道。 后者是:连接较大城镇或承担城市主干交通的主要道路。

entries.description_en: A road providing access to buildings or facilities, rather than a neighbourhood through road.
entries.description_zh: 通向建筑或设施的接入道路,不是普通住宅区贯通道路。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Service access road with Residential road: A road providing access to buildings or facilities, rather than a neighbourhood through road. In contrast, A road serving a residential area, without the special low-speed rules of a living street.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“服务通道”误作“居住区道路”:通向建筑或设施的接入道路,不是普通住宅区贯通道路。 后者是:服务住宅区的道路,不自动具有生活街道的特殊低速规则。

entries.description_en: A flight of steps on a path or footway; steps alone do not imply wheelchair access.
entries.description_zh: 道路或步道上的台阶通道,不能据此认定轮椅可通行。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Steps way with Footway: A flight of steps on a path or footway; steps alone do not imply wheelchair access. In contrast, A path mainly or exclusively for people on foot, rather than a generic mixed-use path.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“阶梯道路”误作“步行道”:道路或步道上的台阶通道,不能据此认定轮椅可通行。 后者是:主要或专供步行者通行的路径,区别于一般混合用途小路。

entries.description_en: A road linking smaller settlements or local centres, below secondary roads.
entries.description_zh: 连接较小聚落或本地中心的道路,等级低于二级道路。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Tertiary road with Secondary road: A road linking smaller settlements or local centres, below secondary roads. In contrast, An arterial road linking towns, below a primary road in road hierarchy.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“三级道路”误作“二级干道”:连接较小聚落或本地中心的道路,等级低于二级道路。 后者是:连接城镇的次要干道,道路等级低于一级干道。

entries.description_en: A minor access road such as a farm or forest track, distinct from a general path.
entries.description_zh: 服务农田或林地等地块的次要通行路,区别于一般小路。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Land-access track with General path: A minor access road such as a farm or forest track, distinct from a general path. In contrast, A generic path for walking, cycling or animals, without the exclusive footway meaning.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“农林通行路”误作“一般小路”:服务农田或林地等地块的次要通行路,区别于一般小路。 后者是:可供步行、骑行或动物通行的一般小路,不表示专供行人。

entries.description_zh: 在道路节点控制车辆或行人通行的信号设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Bus stop for this feature: Traffic signals means signals controlling traffic movements at a road location, whereas Bus stop means a point where buses stop to pick up or set down passengers.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“交通信号灯”误标为“公交车站”:“交通信号灯”指在道路节点控制车辆或行人通行的信号设施;后者指公交车辆上下乘客的停靠点。

applicability.combination_note_zh: 降低路缘属性；与过街点或路缘节点主对象组合；不能证明整条路径无障碍。

entries.description_en: A lowered kerb at a crossing or driveway; it does not prove a complete wheelchair-accessible route.
entries.description_zh: 过街处或车道口降低的路缘,不足以证明整条路线轮椅无障碍。

hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“鞋店”误标为“服装店”:“鞋店”指以销售鞋类为主的零售店;后者指以销售服装为主的零售店。

entries.description_en: A shop selling sporting equipment and clothing, not a venue where sport is played.
entries.description_zh: 销售运动器材和服装的商店,不是开展体育活动的场馆。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Sports goods shop with Sports centre: A shop selling sporting equipment and clothing, not a venue where sport is played. In contrast, A facility offering one or more organised sports activities.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“体育用品店”误作“体育中心”:销售运动器材和服装的商店,不是开展体育活动的场馆。 后者是:提供一种或多种有组织体育活动的设施。

entries.description_en: A retailer of paper and office supplies, distinct from a printing service.
entries.description_zh: 销售纸张及办公用品的店铺,区别于复印打印服务点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Stationery shop with Copy and print shop: A retailer of paper and office supplies, distinct from a printing service. In contrast, A business providing photocopying and printing, rather than selling office supplies.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“文具店”误作“复印打印店”:销售纸张及办公用品的店铺,区别于复印打印服务点。 后者是:提供复印和打印服务的店铺,区别于售卖办公用品的商店。

entries.description_en: A large self-service shop selling groceries and everyday goods.
entries.description_zh: 自助销售食品和日常用品的大型商店。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Convenience store for this feature: Supermarket means a large self-service shop selling groceries and everyday goods, whereas Convenience store means a small local shop selling everyday goods and groceries.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“超市”误标为“便利店”:“超市”指自助销售食品和日常用品的大型商店;后者指销售日常用品和食品的小型社区商店。

entries.description_en: A shop selling loose-leaf or packaged tea, not a cafe serving prepared drinks.
entries.description_zh: 销售散装或包装茶叶的店铺,不是提供现制饮品的咖啡馆。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Tea shop with Cafe: A shop selling loose-leaf or packaged tea, not a cafe serving prepared drinks. In contrast, An informal place serving coffee, refreshments, and light meals.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“茶叶专卖店”误作“咖啡馆”:销售散装或包装茶叶的店铺,不是提供现制饮品的咖啡馆。 后者是:提供咖啡、饮品和简餐的非正式堂食场所。

entries.description_en: A shop focused on children's toys rather than general low-cost merchandise.
entries.description_zh: 主要销售儿童玩具的店铺,区别于一般廉价杂货店。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Toy shop with Variety store: A shop focused on children's toys rather than general low-cost merchandise. In contrast, A retailer of many inexpensive product types, distinct from a food-focused supermarket.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“玩具店”误作“杂货百货店”:主要销售儿童玩具的店铺,区别于一般廉价杂货店。 后者是:销售多种低价商品的店铺,区别于以食品为主的超市。

entries.description_en: A business arranging travel services and products, not a tourist attraction itself.
entries.description_zh: 办理旅行产品和服务的营业门店,本身不是旅游景点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Travel agency shop with Tourist attraction: A business arranging travel services and products, not a tourist attraction itself. In contrast, An object or place of interest to visitors, broader than a particular viewpoint.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“旅行社门店”误作“旅游景点”:办理旅行产品和服务的营业门店,本身不是旅游景点。 后者是:吸引游客参观的对象或地点,范围广于具体观景点。

entries.description_en: A retailer of many inexpensive product types, distinct from a food-focused supermarket.
entries.description_zh: 销售多种低价商品的店铺,区别于以食品为主的超市。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Variety store with Supermarket: A retailer of many inexpensive product types, distinct from a food-focused supermarket. In contrast, A large self-service shop selling groceries and everyday goods.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“杂货百货店”误作“超市”:销售多种低价商品的店铺,区别于以食品为主的超市。 后者是:自助销售食品和日常用品的大型商店。

applicability.combination_note_en: Combine with a road to indicate sidewalks on both sides; this does not establish wheelchair access.
applicability.combination_note_zh: 道路两侧人行道属性；与 highway 道路主标签组合；不是独立 footway。 不能作为轮椅无障碍的正面证据。

entries.description_en: Indicates sidewalks exist on both sides of a road; this does not prove wheelchair accessibility.
entries.description_zh: 说明道路两侧均有人行道,不表示人行道本身轮椅可达。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Sidewalks on both sides with Wheelchair accessible: Indicates sidewalks exist on both sides of a road; this does not prove wheelchair accessibility. In contrast, The mapped object has unrestricted wheelchair access, but this tag alone does not establish an accessible route to it.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“双侧人行道”误作“轮椅可达”:说明道路两侧均有人行道,不表示人行道本身轮椅可达。 后者是:对象允许轮椅无障碍使用,但此标签不能证明通往它的整条路线可达。

entries.description_en: An object or place of interest to visitors, broader than a particular viewpoint.
entries.description_zh: 吸引游客参观的对象或地点,范围广于具体观景点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Tourist attraction with Scenic viewpoint: An object or place of interest to visitors, broader than a particular viewpoint. In contrast, A place with a notable view of surrounding landscape or buildings, not every tourist attraction.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“旅游景点”误作“观景点”:吸引游客参观的对象或地点,范围广于具体观景点。 后者是:可眺望周边景观或建筑的地点,并非所有旅游景点都属此类。

entries.description_en: An area for overnight tents, camper vans or caravans, not indoor guest accommodation.
entries.description_zh: 供帐篷、房车或拖挂车过夜的区域,不是室内旅馆住宿。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Campsite with Guest house: An area for overnight tents, camper vans or caravans, not indoor guest accommodation. In contrast, Small-scale, often owner-operated lodging, distinct from a full hotel.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“露营地”误作“家庭旅馆”:供帐篷、房车或拖挂车过夜的区域,不是室内旅馆住宿。 后者是:规模较小且常由业主经营的住宿场所,区别于大型酒店。

entries.description_en: Small-scale, often owner-operated lodging, distinct from a full hotel.
entries.description_zh: 规模较小且常由业主经营的住宿场所,区别于大型酒店。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Guest house with Operating hotel: Small-scale, often owner-operated lodging, distinct from a full hotel. In contrast, An establishment offering paid overnight accommodation, unlike the building type alone.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“家庭旅馆”误作“营业酒店”:规模较小且常由业主经营的住宿场所,区别于大型酒店。 后者是:提供付费过夜住宿的营业场所,区别于仅说明建筑用途的标签。

entries.description_en: An establishment offering paid overnight accommodation, unlike the building type alone.
entries.description_zh: 提供付费过夜住宿的营业场所,区别于仅说明建筑用途的标签。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Operating hotel with Hotel-type building: An establishment offering paid overnight accommodation, unlike the building type alone. In contrast, A building designed for overnight rooms; its form does not prove lodging is currently offered.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“营业酒店”误作“酒店建筑”:提供付费过夜住宿的营业场所,区别于仅说明建筑用途的标签。 后者是:设计用于提供住宿客房的建筑,不能仅凭建筑类型断定当前营业。

entries.description_en: An institution exhibiting scientific, historical or cultural collections, more specific than a general attraction.
entries.description_zh: 展示科学、历史或文化藏品的机构,比一般旅游景点更具体。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Museum with Tourist attraction: An institution exhibiting scientific, historical or cultural collections, more specific than a general attraction. In contrast, An object or place of interest to visitors, broader than a particular viewpoint.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“博物馆”误作“旅游景点”:展示科学、历史或文化藏品的机构,比一般旅游景点更具体。 后者是:吸引游客参观的对象或地点,范围广于具体观景点。

entries.description_en: A place with a notable view of surrounding landscape or buildings, not every tourist attraction.
entries.description_zh: 可眺望周边景观或建筑的地点,并非所有旅游景点都属此类。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Scenic viewpoint with Tourist attraction: A place with a notable view of surrounding landscape or buildings, not every tourist attraction. In contrast, An object or place of interest to visitors, broader than a particular viewpoint.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“观景点”误作“旅游景点”:可眺望周边景观或建筑的地点,并非所有旅游景点都属此类。 后者是:吸引游客参观的对象或地点,范围广于具体观景点。

applicability.combination_note_en: Combine with an existing object to record limited wheelchair access; the specific accessible extent cannot be inferred from this tag alone.
applicability.combination_note_zh: 轮椅可达性有限，具体可达范围不能仅凭此标签确定；须与设施、入口或站台主标签组合。

entries.description_en: Wheelchair access is limited; the exact accessible scope cannot be determined from this tag alone.
entries.description_zh: 轮椅可达性有限,具体可达范围不能仅凭此标签确定。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Limited wheelchair access with Wheelchair accessible: Wheelchair access is limited; the exact accessible scope cannot be determined from this tag alone. In contrast, The mapped object has unrestricted wheelchair access, but this tag alone does not establish an accessible route to it.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“轮椅可达性有限”误作“轮椅可达”:轮椅可达性有限,具体可达范围不能仅凭此标签确定。 后者是:对象允许轮椅无障碍使用,但此标签不能证明通往它的整条路线可达。

applicability.combination_note_en: Combine with an existing object to record lack of unrestricted wheelchair access; do not confuse physical access with legal restriction.
applicability.combination_note_zh: 轮椅不可进入/使用属性；与设施、入口或站台主标签组合；与法律通行限制区分。

entries.description_en: The mapped object is not wheelchair accessible; this physical condition differs from a legal access restriction.
entries.description_zh: 该对象无法供轮椅通行;这一物理条件不同于法律通行限制。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse No wheelchair access with Private access restriction: The mapped object is not wheelchair accessible; this physical condition differs from a legal access restriction. In contrast, Legal or managed access is restricted to private users; it does not describe physical wheelchair access.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“轮椅不可达”误作“私人通行限制”:该对象无法供轮椅通行;这一物理条件不同于法律通行限制。 后者是:法律或管理规定仅私人可通行,不说明轮椅能否通过。

applicability.combination_note_en: Combine with an existing object to record wheelchair usability; do not infer access along the whole route to it.
applicability.combination_note_zh: 轮椅可进入/使用属性；与设施、入口或站台主标签组合；不能推断全程无障碍。

entries.description_en: The mapped object has unrestricted wheelchair access, but this tag alone does not establish an accessible route to it.
entries.description_zh: 对象允许轮椅无障碍使用,但此标签不能证明通往它的整条路线可达。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not confuse Wheelchair accessible with Limited wheelchair access: The mapped object has unrestricted wheelchair access, but this tag alone does not establish an accessible route to it. In contrast, Wheelchair access is limited; the exact accessible scope cannot be determined from this tag alone.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“轮椅可达”误作“轮椅可达性有限”:对象允许轮椅无障碍使用,但此标签不能证明通往它的整条路线可达。 后者是:轮椅可达性有限,具体可达范围不能仅凭此标签确定。
